items.source: An accessor for the MessageBrokerRegistry that ensures its one-time creation and initialization through configureMessageBroker(MessageBrokerRegistry).
items.translation: 用于MessageBrokerRegistry的访问器，确保其通过configureMessageBroker(MessageBrokerRegistry)进行一次创建和初始化。

items.source: A hook for subclasses to customize message broker configuration through the provided MessageBrokerRegistry instance.
items.translation: 子类可以通过提供的MessageBrokerRegistry实例自定义消息代理配置的钩子。

items.source: clientInboundChannel(Executor) and clientOutboundChannel(Executor) deliver messages to and from remote clients to several message handlers such as the following.
items.translation: clientInboundChannel(Executor) 和 clientOutboundChannel(Executor) 将消息传递到远程客户端以及从远程客户端传递到多个消息处理器，例如以下处理器。

items.source: brokerChannel(AbstractSubscribableChannel, AbstractSubscribableChannel, Executor) delivers messages from within the application to the respective message handlers. brokerMessagingTemplate(AbstractSubscribableChannel, AbstractSubscribableChannel, AbstractSubscribableChannel, CompositeMessageConverter) can be injected into any application component to send messages.
items.translation: brokerChannel(AbstractSubscribableChannel, AbstractSubscribableChannel, Executor) 将消息从应用程序内部传递到相应的消息处理器。brokerMessagingTemplate(AbstractSubscribableChannel, AbstractSubscribableChannel, AbstractSubscribableChannel, CompositeMessageConverter) 可以注入到任何应用程序组件中以发送消息。

items.translation: 子类负责配置中向客户端入站/出站通道发送和接收消息的部分（例如，基于 WebSocket 的 STOMP）。
